memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial, for when he has stood the test he will receive the crown of life." — James 1:12

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Righteousness, or our "Just-ship," is the most valuable asset a believer possesses, yet it is often the most targeted by the enemy. Job is our greatest example of endurance; despite losing everything, he refused to curse God, proving that a just man can survive any storm if his heart remains firm. In contrast, David though beloved by God demonstrates how easily we can "just miss" our standing through a lack of vigilance. He grew comfortable, stayed behind while others went to war, and fell into a trap that cost him his peace and his kingdom for years.
Joseph, however, showed us the power of a proactive "No." When Potiphar’s wife enticed him, he didn’t negotiate with sin; he fled, choosing a prison cell over a polluted conscience. This teaches us that keeping our "Just" often requires a physical and spiritual "run" away from temptation. 

We must understand that Satan does not play fair; his traps in these last days are more cunning and subtle than ever before. We are called to a "good fight" that may require us to shed our own pride or worldly desires to remain clean. Do not trade your eternal standing for a momentary pleasure, for the consequences of a "Just Missed" moment can last a lifetime. Be vigilant, stay prayerful, and guard your heart with all diligence, for out of it flow the issues of life.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "Integrity is doing the right thing, even when no one is watching." — C.S. Lewis

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, give me the strength to be like Joseph and the endurance of Job. Help me to never grow comfortable like David did, but to stay on guard every moment. Let my "Just-ship" be my greatest treasure. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May you have the wisdom to see the trap.
May you have the strength to run the other way.
